title: Panzer Dragoon II Zwei
overview:
You Take a Dragon to Flight School - He Takes You to Battle School

Flash backwards to several years before the vicious battle against the empire in Panzer Dragoon 1. In the country of Mechania, dragons are bred for the exclusive use of the Dragoons, or Knights. Dragons with wings are normally executed because they are deemed to be a bad omen by the citizens. In the war with the Empire, Mechania has begun to examine the ancient ways rather than to try to fight a futile war using technological advances. The Empire is technologically more advanced. Randy, the hero, and his newfound friend, the dragon he saved, want to turn the tide.

- The dragon's growth depends on you!
- Go back in time to find out how your fire-breathing friend sprouted his wings.
- Contains 7 all new levels of even more intense, surreal, 360 degree action than the original.
- Revolutionary new game dynamic allows you to choose between paths.
- New Berserk Mode allows the dragon to power up and massacre a barrage of enemies!
